book.name: Nabi Hose Sora
book.title: Hose Nabi Hose Alaa Falan Naxan Sɛbɛ

content.text: Saraxaraline, ɛ ito ramɛ!
Isirayila kaane, ɛ liga ki faɲi!
Mangana denbayana,
ɛ tuli mati!
Amasɔtɔ kitina ɛ tan nan xili ma.
Ɛ bata findi woson na Misipa yi,
e nun luti ratixina Taboro geyaan ma.
Ɛ bata yili tilinxin ge yamaan yɛɛ ra Sitimi yi.
Koni n tan na feen saranma ɛ birin na nɛn.
N na Efirami bɔnsɔnna kolon,
Isirayila mi luxunxi n ma.
Bayo iki, Efirami bɔnsɔnna,
ɛ bata yalunyaan liga.
Isirayila bata a yɛtɛ raxɔsi.
E bata kankan e kɛwanle ma,
e mi fa xɛtɛma e Ala ma.
Amasɔtɔ yalunya xaxinla bata so e yi,
bayo e mi fa Alatala kolon.
Isirayilaa wason nan sereyaan bama a xili ma.
Isirayila nun Efirami bɔnsɔnna muxune dagalanma ayi nɛn e hakɛni,
Yuda fan birama nɛn e fɔxɔ ra.
E na e yɛxɛɛ kurune nun ɲingene ba saraxan na,
e Alatala fen,
e mi a toɛ mumɛ
bayo a bata keli e yɛ.
E bata tinxintareyaan liga Alatala ra,
e diine bari e yangane xa.
Iki, kike keden peen nan luxi,
e bɔxɔn yi kala.
Ɛ xɔtaan fe Gibeya yi,
ɛ xɔtaan fe Rama yi!
Ɛ yɛngɛ so sɔnxɔni te Beti-Aweni yi!
Bunyamin kaane, yaxune ɛ xanbi ra!
Efirami bɔnsɔnna kalama nɛn Fe Saran lɔxɔni.
N ɲɔndin nan falama Isirayila bɔnsɔnne xa iki.
Yuda kuntigine bata liga
alo naxanye e bɔxɔn dan gɛmɛne maxɛtɛma.
N ma xɔlɔn fama e ma nɛn alo fufana.
Efirami bɔnsɔnna ɲaxankataxi,
a yalagixi,
bayo a biraxi fe fune nan fɔxɔ ra.
N bata Efirami bɔnsɔnna tɔrɔ alo setena,
e nun Yuda bɔnsɔnna alo furena.
Efirami bɔnsɔnna to a furen to,
Yuda bɔnsɔnna to a furene dɛɛne to,
Efirami bɔnsɔnna yi siga Asiriya yamanani,
a xɛraan nasiga Manga Gbeen ma a mali feen na.
Koni a mi nɔɛ ɛ rakɛndɛyɛ,
a mi nɔɛ ɛ furen dɛɛne raxunbelɛ.
Amasɔtɔ, n luma nɛn
alo yatana Efirami bɔnsɔnna xa,
alo yata gbeena Yuda bɔnsɔnna xa.
N ne yibɔma nɛn, n siga e ra,
muxu yo mi e bɛ n yii.
N mɔn xɛtɛma nɛn n dɔxɔdeni,
han e yi e ti e sɔnne ra,
e n fen.
E na tɔrɔ tun,
e n fenma nɛn.
